title: SDK retry heuristics and id-key ergonomics with telemetry examples
creator: Rohan Gupta
description: Unify cross-language SDK defaults for retry/backoff, define idempotency key ergonomics for unary and streaming APIs, and add telemetry hooks and examples. Deliverables: language-agnostic heuristics doc, per-SDK primitives + examples, automatic debug telemetry counters, and acceptance tests for resumable streams and dedupe windows.
acceptance_criteria: A single recommendation doc for retry/backoff defaults (max attempts, base delay, max delay, jitter) available in the SDK repo
Python/TS/Go SDKs implement a common Idempotency-Key header with consistent validation and a clear stream-resume token pattern
Telemetry metrics emitted by default: retry_attempts_total, retry_failures_by_reason, id_key_conflict_total, stream_resume_success_total
E2E tests cover: transient 5xx retries, 429 backoff, transport-level disconnect during streaming with resume token, and duplicate suppression within configured dedupe window
Documentation snippets and three runnable examples (python, ts, go) for unary retries and streaming resume
test_plan: Unit tests for retry backoff scheduling (mock clock to assert delays)
Integration tests against a test server that emits configurable errors (500, 429, 503, network drop)
Chaos test that drops packets mid-stream and verifies SDK emits a resume token and can resume with no duplication
Load test to check retry storm mitigation heuristics under burst 429 conditions
comments: 2026-02-25 Rohan Gupta: Created ticket. Drafted initial heuristics: exponential backoff with full jitter, base 100ms, multiplier 2.0, max attempts 5, max delay 10s. Proposed dedupe window for idempotency keys = 30s for hosted, configurable per-deployment.

2026-02-27 Ava Martinez: Design review notes — prefer capped attempts for low-latency endpoints, add adaptive reduction for high QPS customers. Need explicit guidance for streaming: separate resume_token vs idempotency key semantics.

2026-03-02 Design review (Marta Silva): Suggested adding a human-readable SDK error when id-key validation fails and a developer flag to auto-generate id-keys for convenience. Raised accessibility concerns around error message clarity.

2026-03-04 Engineering (Jon Park): Implemented prototype in Python with metrics hooks. Sample metrics: retry_attempts_total{reason="server_5xx"}, retry_backoff_ms_bucket, id_key_conflict_total. Opened PR #1345.
2026-03-07 PM (Leah Kim): Customer cases: mobile clients often need lower max attempts; enterprise customers want strict dedupe windows >60s. Added labels and configurable knobs in SDK surface.

2026-03-09 QA (Diego Ruiz): Found flaky test around streaming resume when resume_token lost. Investigating whether token persistence should be up to application or optionally stored by SDK local cache.

2026-03-11 Rohan Gupta: Decision log - SDKs will expose two primitives: IdempotencyKey (for unary requests) and ResumeToken (for resumable streams). SDK will optionally persist ResumeToken to a user-provided storage callback; default is in-memory with a sample-backed TTL = dedupe_window * 2.

2026-03-12 Ava Martinez: Updated acceptance criteria and added telemetry counters to track agressive retry suppression (retry_suppressed_total). TODO: Add sampling guidance to avoid cardinality explosion in logs/metrics.
rollout_plan: Merge RFC -> feature flag in SDKs (default enabled for hosted SDKs, disabled for on-prem by default). Beta release to early adopters for 2 weeks, collect telemetry, then gradual enable for all customers across language SDKs.
implementation_notes: Backoff defaults: base=100ms, multiplier=2.0, max_attempts=5, max_delay=10s, jitter=full (randomize between 0 and backoff)
429 handling: treat as retryable with longer initial base (base=250ms) and increase max_attempts to 8 for idempotent unary calls only
Idempotency key rules: SDK validates format (uuidv4 or base64 16+ bytes), header name 'Idempotency-Key', server-supplied dedupe window fallback allowed via response header 'X-Dedupe-Window'

Streaming resume: server returns resume_token in midstream error payload; SDK exposes resume_token to caller and can auto-retry using ResumeToken+IdempotencyKey pairing. ResumeToken is orthogonal to Idempotency-Key (resume avoids reprocessing entire payload).
Telemetry: counters (retry_attempts_total, retry_suppressed_total, retry_failures_by_reason, id_key_conflict_total, stream_resume_success_total), histograms for backoff_wait_ms
Developer ergonomics: provide a helper to auto-generate id keys (Sdk.generateIdKey()) and a debug mode that logs retry decisions with sampling to avoid PII leakage

Language specifics: ensure Go SDK context cancellation integrates with backoff timers; TypeScript SDK exposes a cancelToken and observable retry events for UI consumption; Python SDK provides sync+async parity with same default settings
